ui.title: Sales Forecaster
ui.tagline: A weekly forecast you can explain: pulls the open pipeline and your own historical stage win rates, computes the forecast in code with a discount for stale deals, gives commit and best-case ranges, names the deals worth inspecting, and sends a forecast that misses target to the sales head first.

actions.label: Run: Weekly sales forecast
actions.description: Each week Kaman pulls the open pipeline and the win history in parallel, computes a forecast in code from your own stage conversion rates with a slippage discount for stale deals, explains the risks and the deals to inspect, and sends a forecast that misses target to the sales head before posting it.

actions.label: Ask the Pipeline Analyst
actions.description: Pulls the open pipeline and closed-won to date for a quarter from Salesforce.
